fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/TabbedModelOffers.cy.js#UtilityPages - TabbedModelOffers [selectYourTruck] [en] — Select Your Truck TC-TMO-02: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Select Your Truck
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TMO-02
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Select Your Truck
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Select Your Truck page, open Check Offers on the default tab, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Select Your Truck page
2. Click a model card's "Check Offers" button
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
